description: Multi-select dropdown field. Pick MANY options from a list flow, referenced by id via ReferredList — the same list-backed pattern as Select/Checkbox/Radio, differing only in Type and how many values it accepts. Captured live headless via copilot 2026-08-12 (field sweep #45); ids de-identified.
notes: Type is the single word "Multiselect". Its options live in a separate list flow, wired by ReferredList=<list flow id> (see field_currency.json's sibling list pattern and CLAUDE.md ReferredList rules).
The write API never validates a value against the list — an off-list value PUTs 200 and silently clears the field. Read the live option list before writing any value.
Computed: Select-family; a source is family-inferred to fire onClick (Select is live-confirmed onClick, Multiselect unverified). Validation via forge_add_field_validation.
